text: A sculpture of a stylized woman with a smooth ivory-toned face and a bronze-metallic cap rests upon a marbled greenish-yellow and reddish-brown stone base against a muted dark teal wall under soft, diffused indoor lighting. The woman wears a textured, reddish-brown fitted tunic embellished with a pattern of small raised circular studs and a metallic copper-hued pleated skirt that drapes over the patterned stone plinth. The camera angle is slightly elevated, capturing the reflective metallic sheen of the bronze clothing, the smooth porcelain-like finish of the face, and the intricate texturing of the garments and footwear, art deco, chryséléphantine, bronze sculpture

A sculpture of a glazed ceramic attendant figure wears a tall conical cap and a long robe shaded in vibrant green and white. The man has a weathered face with faint white pigment and dark facial features. The figurine rests upon a simple rectangular plinth. The entire object is captured straight-on against a dark grey gradient background with soft studio lighting casting subtle shadows on the surface, ceramic, sculpture, glaze

A sculpture depicts a woman and two lambs, positioned on a large rock base amidst foliage and trees. The background features autumn-colored foliage with golden-brown and green leaves under bright daylight, with harsh, direct lighting casting strong highlights and deep shadows across the stone surfaces. The camera angle is low-angle, looking upward toward the artwork. The color palette consists of chalky white tones for the stone and statue, contrasted against the warm earthy browns and greens of the natural surroundings, public art, stone carving, outdoor installation

A sculpture of a mythological female huntress features a quiver of arrows strapped across her back, rendered in a warm golden-brown bronze material with a polished, reflective metallic sheen. The figure is positioned against a solid, neutral pale-grey backdrop that diffuses the illumination. The lighting is soft and directional, highlighting the contours of the draped garment, the intricate braids of the hair, and the smooth facial features. In the upper left corner, the text "BeverlyHillsAntiques.com" is visible, bronze sculpture, patinated metal, neoclassical style

A sculpture depicts an ancient ceramic statuette of a female figure with prominent double hair buns on the head. The terracotta material shows a warm, reddish-brown hue overlaid with traces of weathered white pigment, particularly on the face and clothing. Draped robes feature incised linear folds across the torso and vertical pleats along the lower garment. Soft, directional illumination from the front illuminates the texture and contours, casting gentle gradients across the surface against a smooth, solid black background. A telephoto lens captures the object from a straight-on eye-level angle, terracotta, sculpture, ceramic

A sculpture depicts a terracotta soldier with a textured, earthy clay surface and reddish-brown painted details on the armor and facial features. The soldier wears layered armor with intricate square plates on the torso, shoulder guards, and a tunic below, set upon a rectangular clay base. The background is a soft, muted cream with a faint, hazy mountain landscape in washed neutral tones, illuminated by diffuse, soft lighting from the front under a low-angle perspective. The bottom of the image features the legible text "samesun.com.alibaba.com", terracotta, sculpture, artifact

A sculpture depicts a seated deity rendered in a metallic material with an applied gold-leaf finish that shows extensive wear and dark patina revealing the dark bronze surface underneath. The sculpture features a rounded topknot hairstyle and draped robes with layered folds that cascade down the front. The setting is minimalist, featuring a solid dark grey background with a smooth neutral gradient. Directional studio lighting from the front illuminates the gilded surfaces, creating soft highlights on the raised folds and casting gentle shadows within the recesses of the sculpture, captured at eye-level with a telephoto lens, gilt-bronze, Buddhist art, Asian sculpture

A sculpture depicts a gray ceramic humanoid statuette standing on a rectangular plinth against a neutral gradient backdrop. The figure wears layered robes with a textured surface, showing traces of earthy red pigment and white residue in crevices. The head features a distinctive hairstyle with a coiled topknot and a stern expression. Soft, even studio lighting illuminates the object from the front, casting gentle shadows downward and highlighting the porous, weathered clay material. The image is captured from an eye-level angle with a telephoto lens, terracotta, funerary art, artifact

A sculpture of a human figure is captured in studio photography against a neutral grey background. The terracotta artifact features an earthy, weathered texture with traces of original reddish-brown and muted green pigments visible across its weathered surface. The sculpture wears a simple, layered tunic with flared skirts and a distinctive capped headdress with a pronounced top knot. Diffuse, soft lighting highlights the granular surface irregularities and subtle contours of the aged clay, creating gentle tonal variations and shadows. The shot uses an eye-level angle with a telephoto lens, emphasizing the cylindrical form and verticality of the ancient Chinese artifact, terracotta, sculpture, antiquity

A sculpture of Joan of Arc is cast in a creamy, off-white material with weathered brown antiquing that highlights the textured details of her armor, flowing skirt, and banner. The figure holds a staff and a small shield, with a diminutive sheep resting near her left foot and foliage sculpted at the base. The banner features the legible inscription "Marie", and the base bears the legible inscription "1412 Jeanne d'Arc 1431". The sculpture is nestled between a dark, rusted iron lattice on the left and a rough, textured stone wall on the right, resting on a gritty surface. Soft, directional light illuminates the front of the statue from the upper left, casting gentle shadows that accentuate its dimensional forms, captured with a shallow depth of field in a neutral color palette, sculpture, figurine, historical monument

A sculpture depicts a human man carved from pale, off-white stone, positioned centrally within a deep rectangular architectural niche composed of stacked, uniform stone blocks. The man wears a form-fitting sleeveless tunic with subtle ribbed texturing, and holds a flat round object in one hand and a rectangular implement in the other. Direct, bright lighting illuminates the scene from the front, casting soft shadows within the recessed alcove. The composition is captured from a straight-on, eye-level angle with a telephoto lens, emphasizing the architectural symmetry and clean, monumental lines. At the base of the architectural niche, carved lettering reads "RECREATION", art deco, architectural sculpture, low relief

A sculpture of a female nude is cast in dark bronze with a smooth, polished patina that catches diffuse, overhead lighting from the left, creating subtle highlights along the contours of the body and casting a soft, dark shadow on the plain, off-white wall behind it. The woman has dark hair styled in an elaborate updo with prominent coils. The sculpture rests on a circular, textured bronze base against a minimalist gallery background under bright museum lighting captured from a slight low-angle perspective, bronze sculpture, fine art, lost-wax casting

A sculpture depicts a dark metallic deity adorned with ornate jewelry and an elaborate tiered crown, positioned on an ornate lotus pedestal. Beside the deity stands a mythical beast with a stylized mane and open-mouthed expression, resting upon the tiered base against a neutral gray background. The scene is illuminated by soft, even studio lighting that highlights the matte textures of the cast metal and the subtle details of the ornamentation. The camera angle is eye-level, captured with a sharp focus on the fine relief work, sculpture, metalwork, bronze

A sculpture depicts a pale white, weathered stone statue centered vertically in the frame against a solid charcoal-grey gradient background. The statue is adorned with intricate carved jewelry, including a reddish-brown collar around the neck and beaded necklaces draped over the chest. The stone exhibits a smooth, slightly worn texture with subtle imperfections and light-colored mineral variations. The lighting is soft and even, casting minimal shadows and highlighting the detailed relief work on the garment. The camera is positioned at eye-level, capturing the object frontally with a clean telephoto lens effect that isolates the statue from its neutral backdrop, Chinese art, white marble, sculptural relief

A sculpture of a terracotta-colored woman is presented in a gallery setting against a neutral, out-of-focus background wall. The figurine rests on a rectangular terracotta base, which sits on a light-colored exhibition surface illuminated by soft, even overhead lighting that highlights the matte texture and granular surface variations of the fired clay material. To the right on the exhibition surface, a small circular label displays the number "4", sculpture, terracotta, museum display

A sculpture of a terracotta-colored female figure wears a hat and raises one hand. The sculpture rests on a rectangular pedestal placed on a flat white surface against a plain neutral background. The lighting is soft and directional, casting gentle shadows that emphasize the three-dimensional contours and grainy texture of the clay material. Captured from a straight-on eye-level angle, the monochrome earth tones create a warm, unified color palette, terracotta, ceramic, sculpture

A bronze sculpture depicts two children cast in a verdigris patina with mottled greenish-brown tones and rough, textured metal surfaces. The upper child rests directly on the lower child, both positioned on a weathered, moss-flecked stone pedestal inside a concrete fountain basin. Autumn leaves are scattered on the ground around the base. In the background, a light-colored stucco building wall, bare deciduous bushes, a low concrete retaining wall, and overcast gray sky are visible under flat, diffuse daylight captured from a slightly elevated angle, bronze, patinated metal, public art

A sculpture of two youthful figures with curly hair crafted from a metallic, golden-brown bronze material with hints of green patina on their garments, mounted on a circular multi-tiered base composed of dark brown wood and mottled green marble, set against a plain, neutral light gray background under even, diffuse studio lighting captured from a straight-on eye-level angle with a sharp focus on the metallic textures and polished stone, bronze, patina, marble

A sculpture of a man and woman made from numerous stacked horizontal metal slices stands on an elevated concrete platform against a backdrop of distant mountains under an overcast gray sky and water. The metallic figures glow internally with vibrant blue and red LED lights illuminating their stacked layers. Captured from a low-angle perspective, the composition emphasizes the towering height of the artwork against the muted evening atmosphere, kinetic sculpture, public art, contemporary installation

A sculpture of a man and a child is located outdoors in a public park featuring a paved stone walkway and manicured green lawns bordered by trimmed hedges and leafy trees. The metallic bronze-toned figures share a modern rectangular bench constructed from metallic slats and legs. The man wears a collared shirt and trousers, holding a laptop computer, while the child wears a simpler tunic-style garment. The scene is illuminated by soft daylight casting gentle shadows on the cobblestone ground. In the bottom right corner, a watermark reads "百家号/山东铸铜雕塑", public art, bronze, outdoor sculpture

A sculpture depicts two individuals rendered in smooth, carved white marble against a neutral gray background. The larger person wears elaborate draped garments over a short tunic with ornate shoulder straps and elaborate sandals, crowned with a wreath. Beside this larger person is a smaller person wearing a draped robe and a headdress, situated on a rock formation. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the textured folds of the fabric and the polished surfaces of the stone under an eye-level perspective, marble, classical, bas-relief

A sculpture depicts two bronze-toned humanoid statues mounted on a rectangular metallic base resting atop a heavy, speckled granite pedestal. The figure on the left wears a knitted blue textured vest, and the figure on the right wears a dark knitted cap. The background consists of dense green foliage with twigs and brambles under bright daylight casting sharp shadows. The composition is shot from a low-angle perspective with natural sunlight illuminating the scene, creating rich contrast against the dark metallic surfaces, bronze, granite, knitwear

A bronze sculpture of two men is situated on a concrete sidewalk in an urban setting featuring historic brick buildings with multi-pane windows under a clear blue sky. The metallic statues exhibit a dark greenish-patina finish with textured, weathered surfaces. Sunlight illuminates the scene from above, casting soft shadows on the pavement, where patches of melting snow remain near the base of the artwork and a nearby ornate streetlamp. On the back of the chair, text is inscribed, reading "August 5, 1977..." followed by smaller block lettering. A small printed leaflet held in one hand displays colorful graphics with the words "BROADWAY" and "CITY" visible near the top, sculpture, bronze, urban art

A sculpture of two bronze and green metallic figures, one a dark copper-brown woman with a sword and shield, the other the iconic green Statue of Liberty holding a torch aloft and a book inscribed with text, set against a bright blue daytime sky with soft white clouds, illuminated by direct sunlight creating distinct highlights and deep shadows across the metallic surfaces, captured from a low-angle perspective, public art, bronze casting, patina

A sculpture of a bronze-green deity centered within a tall, pointed, arched mandorla is set against a dark gray background under soft, diffuse lighting captured from a straight-on eye-level angle, flanked by two smaller attendants on either side of a small vessel on a raised, four-legged platform with intricate scalloped edge detailing, displaying weathered metallic texture and powdery green patina, ancient art, cast bronze, verdigris

A sculpture of a veiled female marble figure in a classical alcove, wearing draped, translucent garments and holding a garland of roses, alongside an inscribed plaque that reads: "D O M PACE ATERNAE CECILIAE GAETANI ARAGONIAE LAURENTIANENSIUM DUCIS ET ROSAE SANSEVERINA SANSEVERIO PRINCIPIBUS FILIA SANSEGRO TURRISMAIOR DUCIS OPTIMAE CONJUGI QUAE ELEGANTIA INGENIO RELIGIONE AC FIDE DEO ENITUIT SAC PIENTISSAR OMNI AEVO FINIS AEQUARI POSSET AECESSIT VII KAL JAN MDCCLIX DUS DE SANGRO FILIUS EXIMIA EJUS MERITA FIMI ET AMORIS MONUMENTO SINT INSIGNIORA PETRI INCOMPARABILIS LUMIN EXCITANDUM CURAVIT ANNO SAL MDCCLII". The pale grey and white marble statue stands against a mottled reddish-brown stone and dark shadowed wall. Direct indoor illumination from the side highlights the fine textile texture, smooth skin, and carved details. The low-angle photograph uses sharp focus and a neutral color palette, Baroque, veil carving, marble

A sculpture depicts a man and a woman in dark bronze atop a pale stone pedestal inscribed with the legible text "BREDERO". The statue stands on a patterned brick pavement next to a dark gray motor scooter, with a teal metal canal bridge railing and parked pink and white bicycles positioned behind it. In the background, a narrow canal reflects the overcast sky, flanked by traditional multi-story Amsterdam canal houses with reddish-brown brick facades and steep gabled roofs under a flat, diffuse, gray cloud cover. The shot is captured from a slightly low angle using a wide-angle lens, rendering cool metallic highlights on the bronze figures against the muted, natural daylight, bronze, stone, public art

A sculpture depicts two monumental, abstract stone humanoids carved from dark grey granite with rough, textured surfaces. The left sculpture features a horizontal, serpentine body terminating in a reclining tail, while the upright figure on the right possesses a flared lower garment and an elaborate headdress. Two men wearing casual shirts and trousers are positioned between the statues on a grassy lawn. The background is a lush, dense grove of green tropical trees and palm fronds under bright, direct daylight that casts soft shadows. The color palette consists predominantly of earthy greys, vibrant greens, and natural skin tones, captured with a wide-angle lens from a low angle, granite, public art, photography

A white marble sculpture depicts a man with his hands to his mouth, accompanied by several children on a stone-like base against a solid neutral grey background in a studio setting. Diffuse lighting illuminates the smooth, polished surfaces and carved textures from the upper left, casting soft shadows across the figures. The camera angle is slightly low-angle. Inscribed on the front of the base is the legible text "Carpeaux", marble, neoclassical, sculptural texture

A sculpture of a bronze-toned doctor in a lab coat with a stethoscope rests outside an urban building featuring glass and stone panels, complemented by natural foliage and palm tree reflections. The palette consists of earthy browns and metallic tones contrasted against cool blue reflections in the glass windows. Natural daylight illuminates the metallic surface, highlighting the textured coat and smooth facial features. The camera uses a telephoto lens from an eye-level angle

bronze, sculpture, realism

A sculpture depicting several white marble figures is displayed in a museum gallery with a cool, muted color palette dominated by shades of gray and off-white. The diffuse overhead lighting casts soft shadows across the gallery space and highlights the smooth, weathered textures of the ancient artifacts. In the center foreground rests a prominent, bearded stone head on a pedestal bearing the text: "Head of Zeus
Greek, late Hellenistic period, mid-2nd c. BC
Melos, Cyclades, Greece

This larger-than-life head is carved in
volcanic tufa basalt. The sculptor used
fine, fine chisel strokes on the interior
expression of melancholiness, in subtle
modulation to heighten the visual impact
of the gold finish. By curving the lips
to a slight angle to catch more light"
Flanking this central piece are multiple other classical statues of draped women and fragments against dark backdrops, captured with an eye-level telephoto lens, museum, antiquities, marble

A sculpture depicts a bronze-toned baseball player in athletic uniform, positioned near a banner that reads "AARON DREAM FOUNDATION" and another vertical banner that reads "EDDIE MATHEWS". The setting is indoors, featuring a stone wall background, wooden ceiling beams, and stacked baseball bats arranged neatly in a grid pattern. Two individuals in formal attire are positioned near a dark podium in the background beneath ambient indoor lighting, with a low-angle perspective highlighting the metallic texture and polished sheen of the statue, bronze sculpture, monumental art
